agyos_skill.instructions: The **ephemeral Stories** content type — interactive frame sequences for Instagram/Facebook's relationship surface. The agent drafts the frames + sticker copy; a human adds native interactive elements and replies in DMs; **scheduling-and-queue → WoopSocial** publishes the base frames. Instagram is explicit — **Stories aren't a discovery/reach surface; they deepen the relationship** with your *existing* followers (and those relationship signals lift your Feed/Reels for them). So optimise for **completion + interaction (sticker taps, replies, link taps)**, never impressions. Reach goals → **reels-script**. 1. **brand-profile** — look, palette, non-negotiables (frames must be on-brand). 2. **voice-builder** — so frame copy sounds like the brand. (Depth: `references/the-frame-framework.md`.) - **F — First frame earns the tap-through:** sound-off hook stating the problem/outcome (most exits happen here); 9:16, safe zone, text sparingly. - **R — Rhythm: one beat per frame:** a 3–5 frame arc (or multi-day mini-series), each a distinct takeaway; keep each beat short (~15s) even though a segment can run to 60s. - **A — Activate with a sticker:** poll/quiz/question/slider/countdown — the single most effective Stories tool; turns watchers into tappers (+ free audience research). - **M — Move to one action:** **one goal per sequence**; link sticker + **"Tap here"** overlay / reply prompt / profile visit. Don't ask three things. - **E — Evergreen + engage:** **Highlight** proven sequences; **DM every reply** personally; read completion/exits/taps natively to learn. 9:16 (1080×1920), key content in the **safe zone (1080×1420)**, **sound-off legible**; video segments run up to **60s** (photos show ~5s) — keep beats ~15s. Post **daily, ~3–7 frames**; mix ~**70% value / 20% BTS / 10% promo**; use **Close Friends** for insider/VIP drops.
